Actual runner tests and browser-flow observations remain bound reports rather than an independently repeated browser run. The 166 prebuild tests with two skipped classes and separate 40 postbuild tests with no skips remain distinguished.

The original 149 guidance rows and 13 policy clauses on two images, and path-only 80e7 review binding, are preserved. Original null scores remain untouched. New evidence-coverage scores disclose definitions and weights.
The unknown-path 404 observation is loopback-only. Public HTTP, provider state, IndexNow, indexing and ranking are unverified.

Mobile fixed bars and sticky headers obscure narrow strips in some captures. Combined full-page and cross-width originals and exact DOM cover the content. Full CTA/footer Tab traversal, focused-state pixels and every-scroll hit testing were not recorded.
External SKU navigation, phone calls, checkout, stock, current facility operation, entry and final delivery cost or time were not validated.
